country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Southend-on-Sea Borough Council Hybrid Cloud Data Centre
notes: Public procurement notice sought a provider to supply, install, commission, and test a Hybrid Cloud Data Centre capability for the council; DCD reported the GBP1.5m tender. No public evidence found confirming final operational status or MW capacity.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: IX Liverpool planned St Helens data centre interconnection site
developer: IX Liverpool / unnamed data centre operators
notes: IX Liverpool says it has other sites planned for St Helens in 2027 with data centre operators once agreements conclude. LCRDC separately markets edge, micro, and core colocation across Liverpool, Sefton, Knowsley, St Helens, Halton, and Wirral, but no named St Helens facility or power capacity was found.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Midlands Supercluster South Staffordshire AI Data Centre Campus
developer: Midlands Supercluster / AI Growth Zone promoters
notes: Promoter site lists South Staffordshire as one of five AI data centre campus locations in a Midlands AI supercluster and states 600MW capacity. No planning application, operator identity, or construction evidence found in this pass.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Latos Stockton / Preston Farm neural edge AI data centre
notes: Latos announced planning approval for a GBP100m neural-edge AI data centre at Preston Farm Industrial Estate, Stockton-on-Tees. Public reports describe two data halls totaling about 1,750 sqm and expected opening in early 2027; no MW capacity figure found.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: GreenWeaver / Spode Works Josiah 1 AI data centre
developer: Spode Works Regeneration Ltd / Dog & Bone Group; GreenWeaver AI as operator
notes: Plans were submitted for an AI/HPC data centre within the historic Spode Works/Potbank expansion, with waste-heat reuse. Data Center Map lists the GreenWeaver Stoke-on-Trent facility as up to 30MW; planning-listing evidence shows application 25/FUL/00668 for conversion of Building 4A to remote computing AI data centre.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: IPswiTch Group Ipswich colo data centre
notes: Data Center Map lists IPswiTch Group's colo service as based at its data centre in Ipswich, Suffolk, supporting colocation from 1U devices to multiple racks. No MW capacity or recent expansion project found.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Ark Data Centres Longcross Park / LP02 expansion
notes: Ark operates the Longcross Park campus in Surrey. Public reports say Ark is investing GBP807m, with planning approval for vertical extensions, supporting infrastructure upgrades, and a new 36MW LP02 facility; Nebius is expanding its AI cloud deployment at the campus after an initial 16MW lease.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Aegis One Godalming data centre
notes: Colo-X lists Aegis One at Data Park, Cattleshall Lane, Godalming, Surrey, opened in 2014 with up to 1,500 sqm net technical capacity possible in phase 1, but notes it entered administration in Q4 2018. Current operating status was not confirmed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Digital Space Telford Data Centre
notes: Digital Space's official colocation page lists its Telford Data Centre at Hortonwood 37, Donnington, with 2,000 kVA total capacity, up to 10kW per rack, N+2 UPS, N+1 diesel generators, direct cloud connectivity, and Tier 3 certified facility claims. Capacity left null because source is in kVA rather than MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: SysGroup Telford Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists a SysGroup data centre at Grosvenor House, Central Park, Telford, acquired from Rockford IT in November 2017. Specs page lists colocation services and ISO27001 but no power/capacity data.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Equinix MA3 Trafford Park
notes: Equinix official page locates MA3 at 76 Trafford Wharf Road. DCD reported the leased Joule House facility is around 3MW with about 30,000 sq ft technical space; Datacenters.com lists the Trafford Park facility at 46,500 sq ft.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Pulsant Manchester NW-1 Trafford Park expansion
notes: Pulsant announced opening of a GBP4.5m new data hall at its Trafford Park Manchester facility in March 2024. Data Centre Review reported the upgrade added 300kW and that the site offers about 1MW across four data halls and 400+ racks.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: ANS MaNOC 5, 6 and 7 Trafford Park data centre complex
notes: Colo-X describes MaNOC 5, 6 and 7 as a secure complex of adjacent buildings on Cobra Court, Trafford Park, with a 3.5MVA incoming feed and about 650 racks; Data Center Map lists the operator/address. Capacity left null because source reports MVA rather than MW.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Deep Green DG01 move Urmston Leisure Centre data centre
notes: Deep Green identifies DG01 at move Urmston Leisure Centre in Trafford as a lighthouse compact data centre project; ITS says it is next to the leisure centre and supports high-performance compute with heat reuse. Data Centre Magazine reported heat is redirected to Trafford Leisure Centre's swimming pool and supports up to 150kW rack densities. No facility MW capacity found.
